run.prompt: Explicitly create and publish one simple synthetic demo product named Urumi Demo Mug, regular price 199.00 INR, SKU RELAY-M4-10c7eee5. Set description to Synthetic assessment demo; not a real shipment. Use the WooCommerce create_product tool. Report the actual product ID, price and storefront link.

tools.description: Actual current UTC instant and local time in an explicit IANA timezone.
Half-open UTC bounds [start,end) for a local calendar date (or today). Handles DST; pass bounds to list_orders.
A single explicit page of WooCommerce products, ordered by ID. Follow next_page to collect more. Prices are store-currency decimal strings.

Create one simple product. Defaults to published/visible, decimal price in configured store currency. Require a unique SKU; never automatically retry a timed-out write. Reconcile unknown outcomes by listing that SKU.

A single explicit page of orders (ID ascending). Optional UTC second-precision after/before form a half-open interval [after,before). Use Calendar day_range; follow next_page. Omits customer/private metadata.
Get one order by its positive ID. Money and creation time are exact; customer/private metadata is omitted.
Set one order to a supported WooCommerce status. Status assignment is repeatable but Woo hooks may have effects. Never automatically retry an ambiguous write; reconcile with get_order.
Exact sum of up to 1000 decimal strings. Never uses floating point; precision must match the declared currency.
Exact sum of unique order IDs from explicitly collected pages. Rejects mixed currencies and duplicates. This is a submitted-data total, not a claim that all orders were fetched.
